surface_name: OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens, consent screen in Testing
title: Google refresh token dies every 7 days with invalid_grant
symptoms: Agent works for a week after re-authorizing, then fails again
cause: While the OAuth consent screen's publishing status is Testing, Google expires refresh tokens after 7 days.
fix: Publish the consent screen to Production. For a private app this shows an unverified app warning once at sign-in, which is acceptable. If invalid_grant appears on a published app, the token was revoked; mint a new one.
apply: Google Cloud console > Google Auth Platform > Audience > Publish app (older console layout: APIs & Services > OAuth consent screen)
